mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_sales_order_hd ( tenant_id, order_no, order_dt, customer_id, quot_no, delivery_dt, delivery_place, delivery_method, status, total_amt, remark, created_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{orderNo}, CAST(#{orderDt} AS date), #{customerId}, #{quotNo}, CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), #{deliveryPlace}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{status}, #{totalAmt}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} ) RETURNING sales_order_id

INSERT INTO tb_sales_order_dt ( sales_order_id, tenant_id, line_no, material_id, order_qty, unit_price, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, delivery_dt, shipped_qty, line_status ) VALUES ( #{salesOrderId}, #{tenantId}, #{lineNo}, #{materialId}, #{orderQty}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyAmt}, #{vatAmt}, #{totalAmt}, CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), #{shippedQty}, #{lineStatus} ) RETURNING sales_order_detail_id

SELECT h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, h.tenant_id AS tenantId, h.order_no AS orderNo, h.order_dt AS orderDt, h.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, h.quot_no AS quotNo, h.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, h.delivery_place AS deliveryPlace, h.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, h.status AS status, h.total_amt AS totalAmt, h.remark AS remark FROM tb_sales_order_hd h LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = h.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id WHERE h.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.use_at = 'Y'

SELECT d.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, d.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, d.tenant_id AS tenantId, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, d.order_qty AS orderQty, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, d.vat_amt AS vatAmt, d.total_amt AS totalAmt, d.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, d.shipped_qty AS shippedQty, d.line_status AS lineStatus FROM tb_sales_order_dt d LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY d.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sales_order_hd SET order_dt = CAST(#{orderDt} AS date), customer_id = #{customerId}, quot_no = #{quotNo}, delivery_dt = CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), delivery_place = #{deliveryPlace}, delivery_method = #{deliveryMethod}, total_amt = #{totalAmt}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
UPDATE tb_sales_order_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND use_at = 'Y'
